summary.text: Sills is the Natural Law Party nominee for Michigan's 2nd District. According to Ballotpedia, he has worked in meat processing, printing and marketing and farming.

paragraphs.text: A native of the Cincinnati area who moved to Michigan in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.
Worked in the meat-packing industry and owned two meat processing plants in Michigan; Ballotpedia says he was involved in implementing a federal safety-standards program for the industry.
Also worked in the printing and marketing industries and, when he entered the 2018 election, was an ostrich farmer.
